subject: Meet the Next Generation of Image AI Builders This October
body:
Hi there,

My name is Ishaan Cherukuri, and I am a high school student organizing Banana Hacks, a free virtual hackathon for high school students running October 9 to 11, 2026, themed entirely around image AI, computer vision, and generative models.

Please feel free to look at a document debrief of what a partnership with Banana Hacks entails. I am happy to send it over on request.

Thank you so much for your time.
